purpose: Agent-owned candidate ideas for autonomous product evolution. Candidates are not commitments until promoted to backlog/tasks.json with acceptance criteria and validation evidence.

scoring.userImpact: How much clearer, more useful, or easier the mock finance workflow becomes.
scoring.presentationValue: How much the change improves a credible demo or portfolio presentation.
scoring.evidence: Support from user-flow observation, browser checks, test gaps, or established UX quality criteria.
scoring.risk: Implementation, regression, and scope risk; lower is better.

lastDiscovery.summary: After EVOLVE-003, seeded idea pool was exhausted. Replenished with operational docs (promoted), optional behind-pace demo seed, and a11y focus polish candidates. Gate still open on operational readiness.

candidates.title: Clarify monthly spending patterns with an accessible visual breakdown
candidates.hypothesis: A compact, accessible category visualization could make the monthly story more immediately understandable than a list alone.

candidates.title: Improve first-use guidance and demo narrative
candidates.hypothesis: Lightweight explanation of the mock account, goal workflow, and recommendation logic could reduce ambiguity for first-time viewers.

candidates.title: Strengthen state feedback across the dashboard
candidates.hypothesis: More deliberate loading, saving, empty, and error feedback could make the product feel more dependable in a live demo.

candidates.title: Document local run and operational readiness
candidates.hypothesis: A first-time operator cannot confidently demo the app without explicit install/env/seed/run steps in README.

candidates.title: Make discretionary cut suggestions visible in the default demo path
candidates.hypothesis: Default on-pace seed hides the recommendation list; a documented or seeded behind-pace path could make that MVP capability easier to demo.
candidates.notes: Deferred: EVOLVE-004 demo tips cover goal adjustment; final RELEASE_READINESS verifier judged non-necessary.

candidates.title: Polish focus order across new guide and retry controls
candidates.hypothesis: Explicit focus-visible and logical tab order on DemoGuide and Retry controls would strengthen accessibility evidence.
candidates.notes: Deferred: optional polish; not required for presentation-ready release per final verifier.
